summary: Master NGO partnership growth. Learn stakeholder mapping, due diligence, and consortium building to scale impact and funding. Enroll in our 5-day expert course.
lede: Networking and Partnerships for NGO Growth helps non-governmental organizations turn relationship-building into a strategic growth practice. You will learn to identify stakeholders, develop high-value alliances, and manage partnerships with corporate entities and public institutions through the full partnership lifecycle. The course builds practical skills in negotiation, MOU drafting, due diligence, joint bidding, and partnership performance measurement. You will also explore partnership archetypes, digital CRM tools, the Theory of Change, Partnership Brokering Association standards, and the Collective Impact Model to create a partnership roadmap aligned with your organization’s growth targets.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is built for development professionals who are responsible for expanding their organization's footprint and securing diverse revenue streams through collaborative action.
audience: Business Development Managers in the non-profit sector
modules: NGO Ecosystem and the Partnership Imperative
The Collective Impact Model for NGOs
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in NGO management, fundraising, or program implementation. Familiarity with basic project management cycles and donor reporting is recommended. No advanced technical skills are required, though a basic understanding of CRM concepts is helpful.
